## Business-agnostic check

This repo stays business-agnostic. Confirm the change follows [Stay business-agnostic](https://github.com/abenjamin765/design-dash/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#stay-business-agnostic) in CONTRIBUTING.md:

- [ ] No hardcoded user or machine paths
- [ ] No company, product, or team names
- [ ] No proprietary design systems
- [ ] No named compliance regime (state the general concern)
- [ ] Examples use a neutral domain
